info.name: Kiddo Admin API
info.description: API collection for the Kiddo Admin content management frontend. Import into Postman and create a Mock Server from this collection to develop the frontend against realistic responses.

request.description: Authenticate and obtain a JWT token. Store access_token in the token collection variable.
Get the authenticated user's profile. Used by AppNavbar and AppSidebar.
List all categories with full details. Called on initial page load to populate sidebar and main view.

response.name: 200 - Categories list

request.description: Create a new category. Backend generates folder, per-language voice files, and a DALL-E icon.
Get full details for one category: objects, images, voices, CSV word lists.

request.description: Rename a category. Moves folder, regenerates voice files, renames icon.
Delete or archive a category and all its contents.

response.name: 200 - Archived
response.body:
{
  "archived": true,
  "name": "nature_scenes",
  "archive_folder": "nature_scenes_1738456789",
  "destination": "/data/archive/nature_scenes_1738456789",
  "message": "Category 'nature_scenes' has been archived to nature_scenes_1738456789 and removed from content."
}

request.description: Restore an archived category back to the content directory.
Upload or replace the category icon image.
List voice files for a category, one per supported language.

response.name: 200 - Voices list

request.description: Upload or replace a category voice file for a specific language.
Regenerate a category voice file using the TTS pipeline (translate + synthesize).
Create a new image/item. Saves image, translates name to all languages, generates per-language voice files.
Get full details for one image/object including files, thumbnail, and per-language voices.

request.description: Rename an image/object. Updates folder, CSVs, and regenerates voice files.
Delete an image/object and all its files, voices, and CSV entries.
Add an additional image file to an existing object.
Replace an image file at a specific 1-based index position.
Delete an image file at a specific 1-based index. At least one file must remain.

response.name: 400 - Cannot delete last file

request.description: Upload or replace a voice file for one language on an image/object.
Regenerate a voice file for one language using the TTS pipeline (translate + synthesize).
